execution.mode: local CPU inference with no external model-provider calls
execution.permissions: read model and runtime artifacts; write only the experiment state directory

stop_rules: stop if the runtime exits during model load
stop if either artifact hash or size differs from the frozen contract
stop if any prompt returns fewer than 64 tokens
stop after the three-prompt target and DFlash2 smoke; do not enter the paired throughput rotation automatically
classify output mismatch, swap use, or peak memory above 28.5 GiB as a failed smoke gate
artifact_residency: Raw models, server logs, prompt responses, and full trajectory remain on quant. Only compact reviewed receipts, source, and hashes may be synchronized to Git.
